1.w: I exhort, therefore, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, [and] thanksgivings to be made for all men,

2.w: for kings and all those being in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.

3.w: This [is] good and acceptable before God our Savior,

4.w: who wants all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

5.w: For [there is] one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

6.w: the One having given Himself [as] a ransom for all, the testimony in their own proper times,

7.w: in regard to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I speak the truth; I do not lie—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

8.w: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and dissension.

9.w: Likewise also women [are] to adorn themselves in respectable apparel, with modesty and sound-mindedness, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or costly clothing,

10.w: but with what is proper to women professing the fear of God through good works.

11.w: Let a woman learn in quietness, in all submission.

12.w: But I do not permit a woman to teach, nor to use authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

13.w: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

14.w: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, has come into transgression.

15.w: But she will be saved through childbearing, if they remain in faith and love and holiness, with sound-mindedness.
